system.description:
3rd Level Clan Feature

As a Sarutobi, you are a versatile Swiss army knife of skill and options. You are able to mix it up and use any form of combat you see fit to unlike all others.

This technique manifests itself into a unique stance known as Cross-Style. This stance is unique in that it counts as a Chakra, Taijutsu and Bukijutsu stance all at once. You can enter your Cross-Style stance as a bonus action. While in this stance, you gain the following benefits.

Chakra Powered Strikes. Your unarmed damage die becomes 1d6. Your [Unarmed Damage] and [Weapon Damage] types becomes the damage type associated with the nature release you selected for Advanced Nature Affinity (Medical = Poison).

Unified Form. Once per turn, when you cast a Jutsu (Ninjutsu, Genjutsu, Taijutsu or Bukijutsu) as an Action, you can spend a number of Will based on the jutsu’s rank (D-Rank: 1, C-Rank: 2, B-Rank: 3, A-Rank: 4, S-Rank: 5) to cast a second jutsu of a different discipline but the same rank as part of the same action. The second jutsu must have the same casting time and neither jutsu can require concentration or benefit from cost reduction effects. Once you do, you cannot spend your Bonus action to cast a jutsu until the beginning of your next turn. You gain a benefit based on the order in which you cast the chosen jutsu:

Any > Ninjutsu: Affected creatures with ranks of a Physical, Elemental, or Sensory condition suffer a -1 to their saving throw against the Ninjutsu cast.

Any > Taijutsu: The initial jutsu cast gains the Combo keyword and when the Taijutsu deals damage, the affected creature is pushed 10 feet in a direction of your choice.

Any > Bukijutsu: The initial jutsu cast gains the Chain keyword and when the Bukijutsu deals damage, the affected creature has a -1 to their AC until the beginning of your next turn.

Any > Genjutsu: Select a willing allied creature within half your movement speed range. You each teleport and swap places with each other.
